ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department. This is an online course taught on Compass with no classroom sessions. However, you must be present for evening exams at 7:00 pm on November 2 and November 16, the final exam date and time to be announced at a later date. Course is limited to first 500 students who enroll (no waiting list), and will be opened for registration on August 23, 2010. Further information at: http://go.illinois.edu/NRES102.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s).
